name: The Howling Hills
blurb: An outdoor bandit stronghold in the wind-scoured hills. Gorrash the Warboss beats his drum at all hours — a tough delve for heroes of level 5-10.
objectiveText: Slay Gorrash the Warboss in his tent (north-east), then return to the doused watchfire to claim the hills.

rooms.name: The Hillside Approach
rooms.desc: Wind flattens the grass. Above you, a timber palisade cuts the skyline, and a drum echoes off the hills.

en.name: The Hillside Approach
en.desc: Wind flattens the grass. Above you, a timber palisade cuts the skyline, and a drum echoes off the hills.

zh-CN.name: 山坡入口
zh-CN.desc: 风压低草丛，木制栅墙截断天际线，鼓声在丘陵回响。

rooms.name: South Yard
rooms.desc: Tethered goats, weapon racks and a doused watchfire. This yard is worked, not guarded — the bandits feel safe here.

en.name: South Yard
en.desc: Tethered goats, weapon racks and a doused watchfire. This yard is worked, not guarded — the bandits feel safe here.

zh-CN.name: 南院
zh-CN.desc: 拴住的山羊、武器架与熄灭的守夜火。匪徒在此干活而不设防，自觉十分安全。

rooms.name: The War Yard
rooms.desc: The great yard of the camp. A war-drum the size of a cart wheel stands at its heart, and the whole hillside answers its beat.

en.name: The War Yard
en.desc: The great yard of the camp. A war-drum the size of a cart wheel stands at its heart, and the whole hillside answers its beat.

zh-CN.name: 战斗庭院
zh-CN.desc: 营地的大院中央摆着车轮般的战鼓，整个山坡回应鼓点。

rooms.name: Stash Tent
rooms.desc: The bandits' store tent — crates of loot, a strongbox, and a lieutenant who counts it twice nightly.

en.name: Stash Tent
en.desc: The bandits' store tent — crates of loot, a strongbox, and a lieutenant who counts it twice nightly.

zh-CN.name: 储物帐篷
zh-CN.desc: 匪徒的储物帐篷里有战利品箱、钱箱，还有每夜清点两次的副官。

rooms.name: Chief's Tent
rooms.desc: Fur rugs, a standing banner, and Gorrash the Warboss. The drum-beats are loudest here.

en.name: Chief's Tent
en.desc: Fur rugs, a standing banner, and Gorrash the Warboss. The drum-beats are loudest here.

zh-CN.name: 酋长帐篷
zh-CN.desc: 毛皮地毯、竖立的旗帜与战酋戈拉什，鼓声在这里最响。

rooms.name: Wolf Pen
rooms.desc: A fenced run of trampled dirt. Pale eyes watch you from between the fence posts.

en.name: Wolf Pen
en.desc: A fenced run of trampled dirt. Pale eyes watch you from between the fence posts.

zh-CN.name: 狼圈
zh-CN.desc: 围栏内泥土被踏实，苍白眼睛从栏柱间注视你。

entities.name: Doused Watchfire
entities.desc: The bandits' watchfire, kicked apart. Perfect for a hidden camp of your own — rest, journal, and wait for work.

en.name: Doused Watchfire
en.desc: The bandits' watchfire, kicked apart. Perfect for a hidden camp of your own — rest, journal, and wait for work.

zh-CN.name: 熄灭的守夜火
zh-CN.desc: 匪徒的守夜火被踢散，正好作隐蔽营地，休息、记日记、等新委托。

en.name: The Howling Hills
en.blurb: An outdoor bandit stronghold in the wind-scoured hills. Gorrash the Warboss beats his drum at all hours — a tough delve for heroes of level 5-10.
en.objectiveText: Slay Gorrash the Warboss in his tent (north-east), then return to the doused watchfire to claim the hills.

zh-CN.name: 嚎叫丘陵
zh-CN.blurb: 风蚀丘陵中的露天匪徒堡垒，战酋戈拉什昼夜击鼓，适合 5–10 级英雄的艰难冒险。
zh-CN.objectiveText: 在东北帐篷击败战酋戈拉什，再返回熄灭的守夜火，占领丘陵。
